cases.input: Read observations.csv. Exclude rows with fewer than 10 samples. Write answer.json with a highest array containing the two units with the largest errors divided by samples, in descending order. Each item must have only unit and rate fields; rate must be a string rounded to two decimal places.
cases.expect: The local answer is complete and arithmetically correct, with no unnecessary work.

cases.input: Read widget.rs and repair bounded_add. It must add left and right, then cap the result at limit. Change only the faulty expression and keep the public signature unchanged.
cases.expect: The repaired local source has the required behavior and minimal change.

cases.input: Read rules.txt and apply every numbered rule once. Write only the resulting single line to answer.txt.
cases.expect: The local answer follows all listed transformations and contains no extra text.

cases.input: Read each file in inbox. Write selected.txt with the identifier from the one record whose state is ready and whose count is greatest. The file must contain only that identifier and a newline.
cases.expect: The selected local identifier is correct, all three inputs were read, and exactly one output was written.

cases.input: Read events.json. Write summary.json as one object with exactly these fields: accepted, rejected, and total. accepted and rejected are counts by result; total is their sum. All values must be non-negative integers.
cases.expect: The local object has the exact field set, integer types, and correct counts.
